messages:
sophie_finance: Heads-up: during today's reconciliation we noticed a cross-marketplace credit applied to the wrong channel. AWS issued a partner-level credit of $21,400 but it landed on our hosted account instead of the reseller channel. Need quick triage — attaching extracted lines from both exports.

violet_billing: Oof. Can you paste the extract?

sophie_finance: ```
# aws_credit_export.csv
invoice_id,partner_account_id,credit_amount,credit_target
inv-20261001,partner-332,21400,hosted-account

# gcp_recon.csv
invoice,partner_id,expected_credit,reseller_account
inv-20260930,partner-332,21400,reseller-221
```

ashish_revops: That explains the reconciliation delta in the reseller ledger. Looks like our AWS join logic matched partner_account_id to hosted tenancy first. We should have prioritized reseller mapping.

violet_billing: Checking ingest logs... Found transform rule change from 2026-10-01 where prioritization reversed due to a migration PR (billing/PR-2109). The rule now prefers `tenant_primary` over `reseller_mapping` for credit_target.

aws-billing-bot: AWS Notice: partner-level credits may appear in consolidated exports; ensure downstream mapping respects reseller attribution. See https://aws.example/marketplace/credits (automated).

marcus_partners: Partners Ops: partner will expect payout reconciliation. Recommend we reassign the credit to reseller ledger and notify them. If we can't backdate the AWS invoice, we should issue internal reversal entry and notify partner.

violet_billing: Proposed plan: 1) revert prioritization change in billing transform; 2) run targeted re-attribute job for partner-332; 3) if AWS invoice cannot be adjusted, issue internal reversal/credit memo for $21,400 to reseller-221. I'll open a ticket.

ashish_revops: Approve manual internal reversal up to $25k for this incident to keep partner payouts intact. Record approval in finance-approvals.

sophie_finance: Approved by Finance for $21,400 reversal. @violet_billing please create JIRA and tag legal if partner notice language required. Also assign ledger code "REV-INT-CRM" for audit.

violet_billing: Created JIRA BILL-8433 and PR billing/PR-2145 to restore reseller-first attribution. Scheduled re-attribute job 2026-10-04 05:00 UTC. If re-attribute succeeds we'll void the internal reversal and post an adjusting entry.

gcp-marketplace-bot: GCP advisory: ensure cross-marketplace credit mapping is reconciled during monthly cutover to avoid double postings (automated).

marcus_partners: I'll prepare partner comms and hold until we confirm re-attribute. If we issue internal reversal, I'll include clear audit trail and expected timeline.

violet_billing: Re-attribute dry run locally shows credits correctly applied to reseller-221. I'll post final run results here after the 05:00 UTC job.

sophie_finance: Thanks — recording approvals here for audit: Ashish RevOps approved up to $25k; Sophie Finance approved $21,400 on 2026-10-02.

ashish_revops: One more ask: add an alert for future credit attribution mismatches to the billing monitoring dashboard (token: BILL_ATTR_01).

violet_billing: Added monitoring alert and smoke test. Posting job result in this thread after execution.
